The '''Revkinn V Posting Agency''' was a [[Posting Agency]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Revkinn V]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] hired by [[Imperial Prefect]] [[Dengless Rinn]] consulted the Revkinn V Posting Agency for information on the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Jondrell Inx]].
